description: "On the Curability of Certain Forms of Insanity, Epilepsy, Catalepsy, and Hysteria in Females" by Baker Brown is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The work focuses on the surgical treatment of specific nervous disorders within women, such as hysteria and epilepsy, arguing that many of these conditions are curable through physical intervention.
